notes: PnL, break-even, liquidation, position sizing, funding cost, average entry and hedge ratio are useful deterministic-style cross-check surfaces.
These functions overlap existing Crypto Autopilot risk and execution calculations and must not become a second canonical risk authority.
A future comparison should use identical synthetic/non-holdout inputs and record discrepancies rather than silently accepting upstream outputs.
The reviewed repository does not contain the hosted core formula implementation.
The claimed 35 canonical verification vectors are not available here as independently inspectable source fixtures.
The deterministic and verification claims are therefore service metadata, not an independently reproduced local proof.
The example RiskAgent exposes approved/verdict/isSafe/preTradeGate outputs and demonstrates gating execution on them.
Those outputs embed upstream defaults and thresholds not governed by Crypto Autopilot.
They must not authorize Portfolio Admission, strategy selection, paper/live execution or real-money orders.
Actual calculator use is hosted over Streamable HTTP or through tradingcalc-sdk.
Anonymous access is documented as free at 20 calls/day; an optional free bearer key raises the documented quota to 200/day.
No hosted call or bearer-key use is authorized by this evaluation.
system.verify is documented to run 35 canonical vectors on the hosted service.
Without local source for the vectors and implementation, a remote PASS cannot establish independent mathematical equivalence.
A future runtime receipt may record the result only as upstream challenger evidence.
The reviewed service also exposes on-chain and Kalshi-oriented tools.
They are not needed for the current risk cross-check objective and are not activated by this evaluation.

overall_decision.recommended_next_step: Check whether Crypto Autopilot already has sufficient native deterministic risk-calculation tests. Only if a real gap exists, add a small local synthetic cross-check harness; otherwise stop this branch of expansion rather than duplicating risk code.
